rongmei.title: Tingkum hei san ningmei ntau luai the

lines: 1. Tingkum hei san ningmei ntau luai the
Neikhat namu neila duango zianmei nun
Ntau hei kagan guang tang the
Lung chang phung nipui gan guang tang puthe
He, zianmei nun le guang kariu o,
Asei hei chungsipui gan guang tang the,
Ngammei kam neila duango zianmei nun
Nzianmei arup nun thiu le.
2. Nzianmei nunle neihla na nduango
Matat khatna sini mpatlou rio,
Simei rui lung ti rianra lou
Lung neila khang poubaomei khou nei o.
3. Guang ntanglou tucho nzianmei nun
Poubaomei zauzian paanrui ariu datni,
Hanguang dat nuni tuang ram the
Chamdaan luailou ngam the kapumma tei.
4. Nzianmei nun le ntam kandi kho,
Ata pat lou tho he nzianmei nunle,
Ntammei hei naidat mak khang
Poubaomei taan nthukna taanc di kho.
